summary: The marketing team is in execution mode on two fronts: finalizing the knowledge website redesign and ramping up search visibility for Asia Star and the newly launched Intelligent China program, while navigating a time-sensitive email lockout and preparing for the Nov 13 EuroCham APEC event.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is an Outlook account lockout caused by stale password caches; the team must delete and re-add accounts, update passwords on all devices, and confirm backend unlock with JSB to restore email access. On the website front, the knowledge redesign is nearing completion: the team has settled on keeping the current layout with menu categorization changes, removing the standalone video section, and integrating BCI/BSI indices, but Joseph must share the HTML inspiration file and hold a working session with Julie and the team lead to finalize feedback before Joker implements changes. The global marketing strategy sync prioritized Asia Star and Intelligent China for search visibility, targeting top-five rankings for China programs; with the Intelligent China webpage launching this week, Joseph needs to draft target areas/prompts, analyze participant profiles and CRM leads, and obtain the conversion tracking brief from the SEO manager to enable optimization. Looking ahead, the team must align on outstanding items for the Nov 13 EuroCham Shanghai APEC event, where Prof. Tao is confirmed as speaker, and Ira ZAKA will share the ESG report draft with Julie next week, triggering follow-up for missing materials from departments. Additionally, LIU Jing (Jay) is leading the response to the Yili Group enquiry and must monitor progress closely.
